title: On the branes behind scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ flux vacua
summary: We investigate the brane origin of supersymmetric and scale-separated AdS$_3$ flux vacua arising in a class of type IIB orientifold reductions with G$_2$-structure. First, using the effective three-dimensional supergravity together with explicit uplift formulae, we trace back the $F_{(7)}$ and $F_{(3)}$ fluxes responsible for scale separation and identify the type IIB background that is probed by the corresponding D1- and D5-branes.
